note: DEMO sample photos for the demo video and for anyone trying the app without a coffee leaf. Shown on the Home screen only when app/config.json has "demo_samples": true; a sample goes through exactly the same steps as a camera photo. Unchanged copies of CC BY files in model/demo_samples/ (sources and licences: model/demo_samples/README.md); the CC BY-NC field photos are never bundled. "credit" is shown next to the photo; "expected" is the app's answer (SMS code), checked offline by tests/e2e/app_offline.mjs.
